reviews.summary: APPROVE, re-affirmed over snapshot v4 after a from-scratch re-verification. The first APPROVE crossed with the round-3 submission, so it was issued over a tree that predated the two items the reviewer had marked optional (the stronger D9 framing in three places, and the panic-invariant comment); the reviewer re-ran every check on v4 rather than carrying the approval forward, because handler.go and output.json had both changed after the materialization it had previously checked. All seven criteria verified on v4 by the reviewer, not taken from the writer's report. Fidelity: J(d,p) = V*(externality - ownGood) + capacity matches sim/edpp.go:1688-1779 term for term, V=8 kept unfolded, capacity gated off, composite kernel exclusive, causal admission gating intact in cLocalAfter/cDisagg, rem<0 skipped, the three forced settings hard-wired, the unconditional overlap max(), c_xfer at exactly one site, thetaD for decode re-timing on both branches, and the joint D + D*P argmin with ID-sorted determinism and a strict 1e-12 threshold; every config.md section 5 signal consumed by its stated route, and both divergences from the specification (D9's fold on abort, and the lowest-ID decode-eligible pick when a_r is absent) declared with bias directions rather than silent. Code quality: interface signatures verified against the pin with compile-time assertions, 188 tests including the real token producer end to end, gofmt/vet/golangci-lint clean, -race green across all five profilehandlers, ./pkg/epp/scheduling/... and ./pkg/epp/framework/... green. Registration: both kebab-case type constants, both factories matching FactoryFunc, PickerConfigParser matching ConfigParserFunc, three-arg Register plus RegisterWithPluginDependencies at StabilityBeta at cmd/epp/runner/runner.go:647-649. Core modification: 34 insertions / 0 deletions, additive, reason and upstream-rebase risk stated, exactly the one declared file changed. Config and assembly: overlay valid, apiVersion is the current scheme, every parameter key matches a json-tagged field under DisallowUnknownFields, scenario name test-asserted against the experiment baseline, and all 28 declared paths re-verified byte-identical with zero strays after the post-snapshot edits. Two reviewer reversals recorded: it withdrew its own `diff -r` verification recipe in favour of per-declared-path comparison, and it withdrew its GetLowerCaseHeaderValue suggestion in favour of the writer's metadata.HeaderNames resolution once the present-but-empty edge case was shown to be live for this campaign, which emits the deprecated header spelling. Reviewer's closing assessment: 'the most carefully declared port I have reviewed in this pipeline. The two degradations you found by tracing rather than assuming -- D9, and the estimate-backend substitution hiding behind a renamed token producer -- are both cases where this port could have reported a plausible goodput number and no reader could have told. That is the standard this pipeline exists to enforce, and this port meets it.'
